facts.text: Tufts houses the Experimental College (ExCollege), an academic department where undergraduates participate in designing and selecting elective courses taught by visiting practitioners and peers.

sources.title: About | Experimental College
sources.quote: The Experimental College offers small, participation-based courses that engage Tufts undergraduates in ideas shaping the world today. Here at the ExCollege, we are dedicated to innovation and collaborative learning and teaching.
